        return part([], [], [], False, ['family_channels_unread'])

    for index, record in enumerate(relationships):
        evidence = checked(record, public, True)
        relation = record.get('relation_type')
        basis = record.get('source_basis')
        cue = record.get('relation_cue')
        term = record.get('source_term')
        related = record.get('related_person')
        reference = record.get('reference_person')
        start = record.get('start_date')
        start_text = record.get('start_text')
        end = record.get('end_date')
        end_text = record.get('end_text')
        valid_start = (start is None and start_text is None) or (type(start) is str and type(start_text) is str)
        valid_end = (end is None and end_text is None) or (type(end) is str and type(end_text) is str)
        basic = evidence is not None and relation in bases and basis == bases.get(relation) and cue == relation and all(type(x) is str and len(x) > 0 for x in (term, related, reference)) and related != reference and valid_start and valid_end
        support_quote = None
        if basic:
            for row in evidence:
                q = row['quote'].lower()
                if term.lower() in q and cue.lower() in term.lower() and related.lower() in term.lower() and reference.lower() in term.lower() and (start_text is None or start_text.lower() in q) and (end_text is None or end_text.lower() in q):
                    support_quote = q
                    break
        directed = False
        if support_quote is not None:
            text = term.lower()
            cue_pos = text.find(cue.lower())
            related_pos = text.find(related.lower())
            reference_pos = text.find(reference.lower())
            direct_order = reference_pos >= 0 and reference_pos < cue_pos and cue_pos < related_pos
            possessive_order = related_pos >= 0 and related_pos < reference_pos and reference_pos < cue_pos and (reference.lower() + "'s" in text or reference.lower() + '’s' in text)
            of_order = related_pos >= 0 and related_pos < cue_pos and cue_pos < reference_pos and ' of ' in text[cue_pos:reference_pos + 1]
            directed = cue_pos >= 0 and (direct_order or possessive_order or of_order)

            add(reasons, 'relationship_' + str(index) + '_not_source_grounded_or_directed')
            continue

            add(witnesses, row)
        event = 'relationship_' + str(index)
        put(facts, relation + '_', [event])
        put(facts, 'agent_', [event, related])
        put(facts, 'patient_', [event, reference])
        if type(start) is str:
            put(facts, 'start_', [event, start])
        if type(end) is str:
            put(facts, 'end_', [event, end])
    residence_cues = {'lives': 'located_residence', 'lived': 'located_residence', 'resides': 'located_residence', 'resided': 'located_residence', 'shared a home': 'shared_located_residence', 'same home': 'shared_located_residence', 'same principal place of abode': 'shared_located_residence', 'member of the household': 'shared_located_residence'}
    for index, record in enumerate(residences):
        evidence = checked(record, public, True)

        persons = record.get('persons')

        valid_end = (end is None and end_text is None) or (type(end) is str and type(end_text) is str)
        basic = evidence is not None and record.get('residence_basis') == 'explicit_residence' and cue in residence_cues and mode == residence_cues.get(cue) and type(term) is str and len(term) > 0 and type(persons) is list and len(persons) > 0 and all(type(person) is str and len(person) > 0 for person in persons) and len(set(persons)) == len(persons) and link in ('in', 'at', 'located at') and type(location) is str and len(location) > 0 and location.lower() != cue.lower() and all(location.lower() != person.lower() for person in persons) and valid_start and valid_end

                    support_quote = q

            put(facts, 'patient_', [event, location])

                put(facts, 'end_', [event, end])

        cue = record.get('birth_cue')
        term = record.get('source_term')
        person = record.get('person')
        date = record.get('birth_date')
        date_text = record.get('date_text')

candidates.prompt: 完整读取 current facts，只输出可由同一 facts witness 验证的 family observations。relationship 除 relation_type、source_basis 和当前来源中的 relation_cue 外，必须标注来源实际采用的 role_form：reference_cue_related、related_possessive_reference_cue 或 related_cue_of_reference；人物顺序和连接结构必须与该 form 完全一致。婚姻句不能被标注成父母、子女或兄弟姐妹。residence 必须选择明确的 residence_form，并在 source_term 中同时出现人物、住所 cue、位置连接词和独立地点；婚姻或无地点的 shared-home 表述不能生成 residence。birth 必须选择与原文顺序一致的 birth_form。所有日期文本须由同一 facts witness 支持；来源只有起点时结束字段保持 null。已读空通道使用 []，未知或未读通道使用 null；不确定记录不得猜测。

value.rationale: 两案都把实际错误直接变成联合约束：关系类别必须与 source_basis 和当前 facts 中出现的关系 cue 一致；转换还验证 cue 在关系陈述中的角色顺序，因此婚姻引文即使逐字存在，也不能支持 father、brother 等关系。住所记录同时要求明确住所 cue、连接词、人物和独立地点，因而不能把“shared a home”本身伪装成地点，更不能由婚姻推出共同居住。日期只在同一 facts witness 明确支持时输出，起始日期不再迫使生成结束日期。两案均保留显式的 son 关系，区分 null（未读）与空数组（已读但无记录），并在语义支持不足时将记录留为 unresolved。第一案由转换识别有限的有向句式；第二案把句式类别也显式放入 schema 并逐项验证，约束更强。
